definition: Letter.presents records content asserted by the letter about Christ Jesus and God. Subject indexes are textual designations, not an equation with case-signature beings. Form names the form-of-God/slave contrast without specifying essence, appearance or Aristotelian form. Equality is the being-equal-with-God expression governed by the negative harpagmos judgment; harpagmos remains lexically unresolved between acquisition, retention and exploitation readings. Emptying is described with slave form and human likeness, not loss of deity; obedience reaches cross death. Exaltation has God as agent and Christ as recipient; the name is above every name without a formal equation identifying it. Universal knee-bowing across heaven, earth and under earth and tongue-confession of Jesus Christ as Lord are the stated purpose, directed to God the Father’s glory, not completed historical events. Lord retains the confession’s title without defining numerical divine identity.
